mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing drive was most worthwhile because the completed picture explains how chest movement draws air in and recoil helps air leave.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the diaphragm was clear but brief; on its own, the result added little beyond showing where it goes.

surprise.text: The carbon dioxide feedback was a useful addition: breathing control responds to chemical feedback as well as sending signals to muscles.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and named slots made the connections understandable.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the breathing and circulation systems support the rest of the body, although the largely predictable assembly leaves me curious whether later choices become more challenging.
